impression_before_control_labels: A calm, tactile workshop self-portrait. The person and bright stitched lantern form the two attention centers, while a used apron, crumpled paper, rings, blue thread, rain-specked window and coastal light make the repair place readable. The two useful hand tasks give the pose a purpose.
strengths: The carried lantern, grip, stitched seam and discarded stock create a connected repair situation instead of unrelated decorative props.
The visible face/hair reference is integrated with the work clothing and window/bench lighting.
The mirror frame and phone grip establish acknowledged self-documentation while keeping the complete repaired object readable.
weaknesses_and_limits: The small smile supports a gentle satisfied impression, while precise tiredness/relief is uncertain.
The actual held screen is not visible; exact screen checking remains unobservable.
The added dark apron is compatible with the open appearance scope; it was not a requester lock or a separately selected candidate.
The lantern reads as warmly illuminated; a hidden internal emitter is not independently verified or part of the selected capture-mode contract.

control_calibration.observed: Personal presence, softly lit skin and a small smile support everyday attraction, while material repair and self-documentation carry the frame. No perceptual intensity score or user preference is inferred from a technical PASS.

supplemental_observations.authority: supplemental selected ordinary candidate/topic observation, not a visual-profile hard gate
supplemental_observations.evidence: One reflected subject visibly grips the phone; its back and camera array face the bounded mirror image. The phone, body, carried lantern and workbench share the same reflected room. This supports the depicted self-portrait construction.
supplemental_observations.limitations: A still cannot prove that a particular hardware camera was active, that a shutter was pressed, or that this synthetic image was physically taken by the depicted device.

supplemental_observations.evidence: The physical wooden boundary encloses a continuous workshop scene with compatible scale/occlusion of the one subject, held phone, lantern and bench.
supplemental_observations.limitations: The visible geometry supports one mirror space; exact three-dimensional calibration and real capture history are not recoverable from this single synthetic view.

supplemental_observations.authority: appearance comparison with the supplied reference; no identity claim
supplemental_observations.evidence: The generated visible face retains the reference's softly defined facial outline, eyes/nose/lip arrangement and short dark bob with wispy bangs. Hair strands and cheek presence are recognizable at native scale.
supplemental_observations.limitations: This is a qualitative appearance comparison, not biometric identity, age or biography verification.

supplemental_observations.evidence: A recognizable paper/bamboo lantern hangs from its rigid handle; a prominent blue sewn seam crosses the translucent paper. Crumpled stock, bamboo hoops and a matching blue spool make material work and repair legible.
supplemental_observations.limitations: The paper stock's exact moisture content, prior damage chronology, first-success claim and festival history cannot be proven; the objects support a plausible repair reading.

supplemental_observations.evidence: The mouth is softened into a small smile and the brow is relaxed, compatible with the repaired-object context.
supplemental_observations.limitations: Tiredness and relief as exact internal states are not established. The face is calm and gently engaged; the author's richer fictional motive remains interpretation.

supplemental_observations.authority: unselected generic baseline gaze observation; not an official gate
supplemental_observations.evidence: Eyes and the phone back are visible, but the screen faces away from the mirror and its surface is not shown. Exact eye-to-screen alignment cannot be confidently distinguished from nearby camera/mirror-directed attention.
supplemental_observations.limitations: Do not promote a small apparent pupil direction into a verified gaze target. sf_096 is exposed but unselected; sf_097 exists only in the uninvoked V1 preflight.

supplemental_observations.evidence: The camera array is visible as hardware appearance.
supplemental_observations.limitations: A still does not show which lens is electronically active or an actual shutter event.
